add-qr-code-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a blank page, and place a QR code image as a semi‑transparent watermark in the top‑right corner using Aspose.Pdf's WatermarkArtifact.

create-button-toggle-annotations-visibil.title: Create Toggle Button to Show/Hide Annotations
create-button-toggle-annotations-visibil.description: Shows how to add a button form field to a PDF page and attach JavaScript that toggles the hidden state of all annotations on the current page using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-sound-annotations-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Sound Annotations to PDF Pages
batch-add-sound-annotations-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF and add a SoundAnnotation to each page, using a distinct audio file for every page.

extract-media-from-screenannotation.title: Extract Media from ScreenAnnotation in PDF
extract-media-from-screenannotation.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages to find ScreenAnnotation objects, extracts any embedded media files via the RichMediaContent hierarchy, and saves them to disk for further analysis.

add-read-only-rich-media-pdf-annotation.title: Add Rich Media PDF Annotation (Read‑Only)
add-read-only-rich-media-pdf-annotation.description: Demonstrates embedding a PDF as a rich‑media annotation in another PDF using Aspose.Pdf with reflection for version‑agnostic access, and disabling all interactive features to make the annotation read‑only.

export-pdf-annotations-to-csv.title: Export PDF Annotations to CSV
export-pdf-annotations-to-csv.description: Iterates through all pages of a PDF, extracts details of each annotation, and writes them to a CSV file for auditing. Demonstrates type‑specific handling of text and link annotations.

add-button-annotation-highlight-text-fie.title: Create Button Annotation with JavaScript to Highlight Text Fields
add-button-annotation-highlight-text-fie.description: Demonstrates how to add a push‑button form field to a PDF and attach a JavaScript action that highlights all text fields on the current page.

set-link-annotation-border-red-width-3.title: Set Link Annotation Border Color and Width
set-link-annotation-border-red-width-3.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through all pages and link annotations, changes each link's border color to red and its line width to three points, and saves the modified document.

add-repeating-text-watermark-artifact.title: Add WatermarkArtifact Text to PDF Pages
add-repeating-text-watermark-artifact.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's WatermarkArtifact to place a semi‑transparent diagonal text watermark on each page of a PDF document.

add-screen-annotation-swf-readonly.title: Add Read‑Only Screen Annotation with External SWF to PDF
add-screen-annotation-swf-readonly.description: Demonstrates how to add a ScreenAnnotation that references an external SWF file to a PDF page and mark it read‑only to prevent user editing.

batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import XFDF Annotations into PDFs
batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files, locate matching XFDF files, and merge their annotations into the PDFs, saving the merged documents.

replace-pdf-page-background-images.title: Replace Background Artifacts with a New Image
replace-pdf-page-background-images.description: Iterates through all pages of a PDF, finds each BackgroundArtifact, and substitutes its background image while preserving the original position.

add-javascript-link-annotation-modal-dia.title: Add Link Annotation with JavaScript Modal Dialog
add-javascript-link-annotation-modal-dia.description: Demonstrates how to create a clickable link annotation in a PDF that runs a JavaScript action to show a custom modal alert dialog, and then saves the modified document.

batch-watermark-dynamic-opacity.title: Batch Add Watermark to PDFs with Opacity Based on Page Count
batch-watermark-dynamic-opacity.description: The example iterates through all PDF files in a folder, computes an opacity value from each document's page count, and applies a centered "CONFIDENTIAL" text watermark to every page using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

create-3d-annotation-metallic-lighting.title: Create 3D Metal Annotation with Lighting and Material
create-3d-annotation-metallic-lighting.description: Demonstrates how to embed a U3D model in a PDF as a 3D annotation and apply lighting and render settings to simulate a realistic metallic surface.

add-sound-annotation-chime.title: Add Sound Annotation (Chime) to PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-chime.description: Demonstrates how to attach a SoundAnnotation that plays a chime audio file to a specific PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

clone-richmedia-annotations-summary-page.title: Clone RichMediaAnnotations to a Summary Page
clone-richmedia-annotations-summary-page.description: Loads a PDF, creates a new summary page, clones all existing RichMediaAnnotations, and places the clones on the new page before saving the document.

create-pdf-button-export-annotations-jso.title: Create PDF Button to Export Annotations as JSON
create-pdf-button-export-annotations-jso.description: Demonstrates how to add a push‑button form field to a PDF that runs JavaScript to collect all annotations and output them as a JSON string.

extract-embedded-rich-media.title: Extract Embedded Media from RichMedia Annotations
extract-embedded-rich-media.description: Demonstrates how to locate RichMediaAnnotation objects in a PDF, retrieve their embedded files via reflection, and save each file into a structured folder hierarchy.

create-link-annotation-remote-pdf-page.title: Add Remote Link Annotation to PDF
create-link-annotation-remote-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to create a link annotation that opens a specific page of an external PDF document when clicked.

add-animated-gif-screen-annotation.title: Add Animated GIF as Screen Annotation on PDF Page
add-animated-gif-screen-annotation.description: Shows how to embed an animated GIF in a ScreenAnnotation on the third page of a PDF and save the modified document.

align-watermark-annotations-to-page-marg.title: Align Watermark Annotations to Page Margins
align-watermark-annotations-to-page-marg.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages, locate WatermarkAnnotation objects, and reset their rectangle so they align uniformly with specified page margins using Aspose.Pdf.

toggle-rich-media-annotation-visibility.title: Toggle RichMedia Annotation Visibility with a Button
toggle-rich-media-annotation-visibility.description: Shows how to add a RichMedia annotation and a button field that runs JavaScript to toggle the annotation's hidden state on click.

add-3d-annotation-front-view.title: Add 3D Annotation with Embedded Textures and Front View
add-3d-annotation-front-view.description: Demonstrates how to embed a U3D model that contains textures into a PDF as a 3D annotation and set the default front view using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-replace-watermark-annotations.title: Batch Replace Watermark Annotations with Current Date
batch-replace-watermark-annotations.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, finds all WatermarkAnnotation objects, updates their text to include the current date, and saves the modified document.

add-word-count-link-annotation.title: Create JavaScript Link Annotation to Show Document Word Count
add-word-count-link-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a link annotation to a PDF that runs JavaScript to calculate and display the total word count of the document when clicked.

add-automatic-background-music-to-pdf.title: Add Sound Annotation with Background Music to PDF
add-automatic-background-music-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a SoundAnnotation that plays a WAV/AIFF file in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and save the modified document.

add-dynamic-page-number-watermark.title: Add Dynamic Page Number Watermark to PDF
add-dynamic-page-number-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to create a WatermarkAnnotation with a page‑number placeholder that updates automatically on each page of a PDF document.

add-rich-media-annotation-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Rich Media Portfolio Annotation with Initial View
add-rich-media-annotation-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF portfolio into a PDF using a RichMediaAnnotation and configure it to open the first file automatically when the page is opened.

change-button-annotation-color-to-blue.title: Change Button Annotation Background Color to Blue
change-button-annotation-color-to-blue.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its form fields, finds button fields, sets their background color to blue, and saves the updated document.

add-multiline-freetext-annotation-line-s.title: Add Multiline Free‑Text Annotation with 1.5 Line Spacing
add-multiline-freetext-annotation-line-s.description: Demonstrates how to add a free‑text annotation containing multiple lines and set its line spacing to 1.5 using Aspose.Pdf.

add-free-text-annotation-light-gray.title: Add Free‑Text Annotation with Gray Background and Rounded Corners
add-free-text-annotation-light-gray.description: The example loads a PDF, creates a free‑text annotation with a light gray background and rounded corners, adds it to the first page, and saves the modified document.

javascript-sum-button-form-fields.title: Create PDF Form with Sum Button Using JavaScript
javascript-sum-button-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF with two input fields, a read‑only result field, and a button that runs JavaScript to calculate and display the sum of the inputs.

add-streaming-rich-media-video-no-downlo.title: Add Streaming Video Rich Media Annotation with Download Disabled
add-streaming-rich-media-video-no-downlo.description: Demonstrates how to embed a streaming video in a PDF using a RichMediaAnnotation and how to disable the download option for security purposes.

create-3d-annotation-with-texture-and-ma.title: Add 3D Annotation with Lighting and Material Settings
create-3d-annotation-with-texture-and-ma.description: Demonstrates how to embed a U3D/PRC model into a PDF as a 3D annotation, configure lighting, render mode, and material properties for realistic rendering.

button-annotation-calc-sum.title: Create PDF Form with Sum Button Using JavaScript
button-annotation-calc-sum.description: Demonstrates how to add text fields and a push button to a PDF, attach JavaScript to the button, and calculate the sum of two input values at runtime.

add-rotated-semi-transparent-png-waterma.title: Add Semi‑Transparent Rotated PNG Watermark to PDF
add-rotated-semi-transparent-png-waterma.description: Demonstrates how to place a PNG logo as a semi‑transparent, 30‑degree rotated watermark on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-button-calc-total-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Button to Calculate Total in PDF
add-button-calc-total-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add an interactive button to a PDF that runs JavaScript to sum two numeric fields and write the result to a total field.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v3.title: Export PDF Page Annotations to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to export annotations from a specific PDF page to an XFDF file and save it next to the original PDF using Aspose.Pdf, loading the optional Xfdf assembly via reflection.

import-annotations-from-fdf__v2.title: Import Annotations from FDF into PDF
import-annotations-from-fdf__v2.description: Demonstrates loading an FDF file, cloning its annotations, and adding them to the corresponding pages of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

import-annotations-from-fdf__v3.title: Import Annotations from FDF into PDF (Version‑Safe)
import-annotations-from-fdf__v3.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, importing annotations from an FDF file, handling different Aspose.Pdf versions via reflection, and saving the annotated PDF.

add-polyline-figure-annotation__v2.title: Add Polyline Figure Annotation to PDF
add-polyline-figure-annotation__v2.description: Demonstrates how to create a polyline annotation from a list of points and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Popup Annotation Linked to Text Annotation
add-popup-annotation-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates creating a TextAnnotation and attaching a PopupAnnotation with custom dimensions, positioned relative to the parent markup, then saving the PDF.

add-bates-numbering-with-prefix__v2.title: Add Bates Numbering Artifact with Prefix to PDF
add-bates-numbering-with-prefix__v2.description: Demonstrates how to add a Bates numbering artifact with a custom prefix and six‑digit format to each page of a PDF using Aspose.PDF, then saves the modified document.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v2.title: Import XFDF Annotations into PDF
import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, optionally import XFDF annotation data, and save the document while preserving its original layout and content.

add-rich-media-video-annotation__v2.title: Add Rich Media Annotation with Video Playback on Double-Click
add-rich-media-video-annotation__v2.description: The example demonstrates how to embed a video into a PDF as a RichMediaAnnotation and configure it to start playback only when the user double‑clicks the annotation.

batch-add-video-screen-annotations__v2.title: Batch Add Video Screen Annotations to PDF Pages
batch-add-video-screen-annotations__v2.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all pages of a PDF and add a ScreenAnnotation that plays a video file, automatically sizing and centering the annotation while preserving the video aspect ratio.

extract-highlight-annotation-to-report.title: Copy Highlight Annotations to a Report PDF
extract-highlight-annotation-to-report.description: Shows how to extract highlight annotations from a source PDF and recreate them in a new report PDF by adding equivalent HighlightAnnotation objects.

create-link-annotation-open-embedded-pdf.title: Create Link Annotation to Open Embedded PDF Attachment
create-link-annotation-open-embedded-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a PDF file into a document and adding a link annotation that launches the embedded attachment when clicked.

toggle-watermark-visibility-button.title: Add a Toggle Button to Show/Hide a Watermark Annotation
toggle-watermark-visibility-button.description: Demonstrates how to add a WatermarkAnnotation to a PDF page and create a button field with JavaScript that toggles the watermark's visibility when clicked.

add-highres-pdf-page-as-tiled-background.title: Add Tiled High-Resolution PDF Background Using BackgroundArtifact
add-highres-pdf-page-as-tiled-background.description: Demonstrates how to use a high‑resolution PDF page as a tiled background for each page of a new document by applying a BackgroundArtifact.

add-diagonal-watermark-annotation.title: Add Diagonal Watermark to PDF Page
add-diagonal-watermark-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent, rotated text watermark across a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's WatermarkArtifact, including font selection, opacity, and alignment.
